Subject: Trial runway request — integration delay with Conduit adapter

Hi Aditya / Marissa,

Quick context: we're mid-PoC with Redwood and hit an unexpected blocker integrating the Conduit adapter. Our engineering lead traced it to a third-party dependency (vendor SDK mismatch) and the fix requires a patch that will take us ~10 business days to validate end-to-end.

We've got a demo scheduled with our execs on 30 Sep and the Redwood integration is the centerpiece. With the current trial window closing before we can finish testing, we're worried the PoC will stall.

Could Redwood consider: 1) a short trial extension (~2 weeks) to cover validation, and 2) a modest credit top-up so we can run end-to-end load tests once the adapter is patched?

I've attached an excerpt of the integration logs (integration_log_excerpt.txt) — the team highlighted the error traces. Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through.

Thanks,

Head of Platform Integrations
